description: This file provides a versioned authentication hashing utility with support for per-organization salts, multiple hashing algorithms (Argon2id, bcrypt, scrypt), and migration logic between legacy and current schemes. It includes functions for hashing, verifying, and ensuring tenant salts, as well as handling environment-based configuration.

methods.name: getPepper
methods.description: Retrieves an optional global pepper string from environment variables.

methods.name: buildHashInput
methods.description: Constructs the input string for hashing or verification, incorporating password, tenant orgSalt, and pepper based on version.

methods.name: hashPasswordV2
methods.description: Hashes a password using the preferred scheme, selecting Argon2id, bcrypt, or scrypt based on availability.

methods.name: hashPasswordV1
methods.description: Hashes a password using legacy static salt with scrypt, for verification of existing hashes.

methods.name: verifyPassword
methods.description: Verifies a password against a stored hash, determining the algorithm used and whether migration is needed.

methods.name: compareHash
methods.description: Compares a constructed input with a stored hash, supporting Argon2, bcrypt, and scrypt formats.

methods.name: ensureTenantOrgSalt
methods.description: Ensures a tenant has an orgSalt, generating and saving one if missing.

methods.name: hashPassword
methods.description: Hashes a password with specified or default version (v2 preferred).

methods.name: verifyAndMigrate
methods.description: Verifies a password and provides migration to current scheme if needed.
